description: Generate a Vastu-compliant floor plan from a high-level brief instead of an explicit room list — give it plot dimensions plus a room programme (BHK, bathrooms, parking, pooja room, etc.) and it infers and places the rooms. Returns up to 3 ranked variants.

facing.description: Compass direction the plot/entrance faces — a name like "E", "north-east", "SW", or a bearing in degrees (0-360). Default: E.

polygon.description: Optional traced plot outline as an array of [x, y] points; normalized onto width/length when provided.

requirements.description: Complete room programme: bedrooms or BHK, toilets or bathrooms, floors, and explicit inclusion flags. No default brief.

bedrooms.description: Number of bedrooms. Required unless bhk is supplied.

bhk.description: Configuration shorthand, e.g. "2BHK" or "2.5 BHK". Includes living/kitchen; a half room adds study unless explicitly overridden.

hasKitchen.description: Include kitchen. Required unless bhk is supplied.

hasLiving.description: Include living room. Required unless bhk is supplied.

hasStudy.description: Include a study. Required unless bhk is supplied.

toilets.description: Number of toilets. Supply this or bathrooms.

name: vastu_generate_plan
